en.sayyid-mohsen-al-husayni-al-milani: 2. All of my scholars narrated to me from Muḥammad ibn Yaḥyā Al-‘Aťťār, from Ḥusain ibn ‘Abdillāh, from Ḥasan ibn ‘Ali ibn Abī ‘Uthmān, from Ḥasan ibn ‘Ali ibn ‘Abdillāh ibn Mughīrah, from Abī ‘Umārah Al-Munshid, who said:

Whenever Ḥusain (a.s.) was mentioned in front of Abī ‘Abdillāh (Imam Sādiq (a.s.)) during the day, he would not be seen smiling until nightfall. Imam (a.s.) used to say, “Ḥusain (a.s.) is the tear of every believer!”
